title: Going Beyond XAI: A Systematic Survey for Explanation-Guided Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model-generated visual saliency maps against human-annotated masks in a gender classification task to assess whether models rely on the human subject or spurious contextual cues (e.g., kitchen stoves or phones).
Surveying explanation-guided learning methods that evaluate recidivism prediction models (e.g., on the COMPAS dataset) to detect and penalize improper reliance on a person's race attribute.
Surveying visual question answering (VQA) research that evaluates whether models rely on language priors rather than visual evidence, using attention supervision to reduce this bias.
